'''Two-Blade''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] that was created in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Biography==
In [[41 ABY]], Two-Blade was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] that was created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], as part of a cloning program that was initiated by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] along many other, although it was unknown who was his genetic template.

Later, the newly constituted [[Community]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] and overthrew the Imperial forces that operated the research facility. For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Two-Blade and all the clones resided on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and only in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], they escaped the facility by stealing a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] that had been flown to the moon by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent [[Kell Douro]] but unfortunately Alpha was killed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]].

Two-Blade and all of the other members of the Community, with the exception of the clone [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], suffered from a sickness as a result of their clone heritage and as they escaped from the research facility, the CloakShape passed through the remnants of the [[Lignan]] cargo of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], which had been destroyed a short time earlier. The Lignan enhanced the clones' perception of the Force and accelerated the effects of their sickness.

Badly sick but still alive Two-Blade survived until they arrived on Fhost where he was left behind on the starship with the corpses of deceased clones as the survivors fled in order to obtained some medication and a new medical starship. Succumbing to the disease, he was killed by [[Nyss Nenn]] with a knife right in the chest, while the latter and his sister, broke into the vessel during their quest to find Soldier for the One Sith.

==Powers and abilities==
Two-Blade possibly received that nickname for his skill with [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]], which had him stand out from the rest of the Community.
